notes.title: 📢 Demo Update + Publisher Announcement!
notes.content:
[p]Hello comrades,[/p][p]We have two important updates to share with you:
[/p][p]🤝 [b]We have a Publisher!
[/b] We’re very excited to announce that Kriophobia will be published by [url="https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/indieio"][b]indie.io[/b][/url]. This partnership will allow us to bring more quality to our game and, beyond that, reach many more players around the world.
[/p][p]🎮 [b]Demo Update
[/b] The Kriophobia demo has been updated! While there are no major changes, we’ve made several minor adjustments and bug fixes to make the experience smoother than ever.
[/p][p]If there’s something you’d like to see fixed but haven’t yet, please let us know.[/p][p]This is a huge milestone for the project, and we want to thank everyone who has been supporting us from the very beginning.[/p][p]
👉 Play the new demo, share your feedback in the comments, and don’t forget to add Kriophobia to your wishlist!
[/p][p]See you in the frozen lands of Siberia, where the cold is deadly.[/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: First Kriophobia Demo Update – Multiple Fixes and a New Platform
notes.content:
[p]Hello, comrades!   

Based on your feedback and from the events where we’ve showcased the Kriophobia demo, we’ve developed a patch that brings several fixes, quality-of-life improvements, and, for the first time, Mac support.[/p][p][/p][p]Here’s a list of the main updates:[/p][list][*][p]🍎 You can now play the Kriophobia demo on your [b]Mac[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]🕹️ We’ve added a [b]video that showcases the Tank and Modern control styles[/b]. You’ll choose your preferred style at the beginning of the game.[/p][/*][*][p]🎨 We've added [b]color blindness accessibility[/b] features.[/p][/*][*][p]🔨 We’ve also implemented a series of bug fixes and general adjustments, such as improved demo flow, better UI feedback for game and enemy states, enhancements to relative camera input, updated credits, and more.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41347121/af19630ee484cb4300d4d03f088883d0eaa4dcde.gif"][/img][/p][p]See you in the frozen lands of Siberia, where the cold is deadly.[/p][p]- Fira Soft Team[/p]

notes.title: 🎮 The Kriophobia demo is now available on Steam for the first time!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=xaZfkSL3hps;full][/previewyoutube]

Hello, comrades! We recently launched the Kriophobia demo on Steam during gamescom latam. You may have already played it by now, so your feedback is very important to help us improve the game experience.

Today, we not only want to announce that the demo is available but also express how important this moment is for us.

[b]Who we are[/b]
Kriophobia is developed by Fira Soft, a small studio based in Brasília. We’ve been in the market for over 10 years, and our main work involves creating games and custom experiences for various clients, because this is how we sustain the company.

However, as passionate game developers, we have always wanted to create our own projects, and Kriophobia is our biggest original project.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41347121/ac5b0128d4d33af05944bd56e2190ef30479860c.png[/img]

[b]Development Journey[/b]
This game has been with us practically since the company's early days, and the story of Kriophobia is closely tied to our own.

We have been working on this project for over 10 years. Initially, it was designed as a mobile game, targeted at tablets. We went through the old Steam Greenlight, attempted crowdfunding, secured public funding, and even restarted Kriophobia more than once.

We never stopped working on Kriophobia throughout the years. Although we often had to prioritize projects for our clients, we always kept making steady progress, little by little.

Now, after all these years, we have a new, updated demo that reflects the current state of the game's development. And, most importantly, we are finally approaching the game's launch, scheduled for later this year.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41347121/a474c8b861fbf6ee3bbced5a23b13a123c6c9862.png[/img]

[b]Reason for the Long Development[/b]
Although we have been working on this project for quite a long time, we never intended to become the next big indie revolution or redefine the survival horror genre. The reason we haven’t finished the game sooner is that we always wanted to make it in our own way, according to our standards of quality, and with the time and resources we had available.

No matter how long it would take, we wanted to create the game according to our vision.

So, when you play the demo (or the final version of the game in the future), you can be sure that this project was made with a lot of care, dedication, and 100% of our abilities.

[b]The Demo Is Just the Beginning[/b]
We are aware of some issues that have already been pointed out and that we intend to fix as soon as possible. These include the lack of [b]colorblind accessibility[/b] in certain puzzles and the [b]presence of incorrect Russian text[/b] in some items, either due to the use of pseudo-Russian or flawed machine translations.

So that’s it, comrades. We’ll see you in the frozen depths of Siberia. But remember: the cold is only the beginning.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41347121/e0b14ea6c4700710ab052fa7c4a20ab522c94584.png[/img]


- Fira Soft Team
